overview:
The Oracle integration provides health and performance metrics for your Oracle database in near real-time. Visualize these metrics with the provided dashboard and create monitors to alert your team on Oracle database states.

Enable [Database Monitoring][2] (DBM) for enhanced insights into query performance and database health. In addition to the standard integration features, Datadog DBM provides query-level metrics, live and historical query snapshots, wait event analysis, database load, query explain plans, and blocking query insights.


**Minimum Agent version:** 6.0.0

[2]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/database_monitoring/setup_oracle/

metrics.name: oracle.asm_diskgroup.free_mb
metrics.description: The unused capacity of a disk group in megabytes, tagged by `state` (DBM only)

metrics.name: oracle.asm_diskgroup.offline_disks
metrics.description: The number of disks in an ASM disk group that are offline, tagged by `state` (DBM only)

metrics.name: oracle.asm_diskgroup.total_mb
metrics.description: The total usable capacity of the disk group, tagged by `state` (DBM only)

metrics.name: oracle.gc_current_block_received
metrics.description: GC current block received per second

metrics.name: oracle.long_table_scans
metrics.description: Number of long table scans per sec

metrics.name: oracle.physical_read_io_requests
metrics.description: Physical read IO requests per second

metrics.name: oracle.physical_read_total_bytes
metrics.description: Physical read total bytes per second

metrics.name: oracle.physical_read_total_io_requests
metrics.description: Physical read total IO requests per second

metrics.name: oracle.physical_write_io_requests
metrics.description: Physical write IO requests per second

metrics.name: oracle.physical_write_total_bytes
metrics.description: Physical write total bytes per second

metrics.name: oracle.physical_write_total_io_requests
metrics.description: Physical write total IO requests per second

metrics.name: oracle.process.pga_maximum_memory
metrics.description: PGA maximum memory ever allocated by process

serviceChecks.name: Can Connect
serviceChecks.description: Returns OK if the integration can connect to the oracle database, CRITICAL otherwise

serviceChecks.name: Can Query
serviceChecks.description: Returns OK if the integration can run all the queries, CRITICAL otherwise
